categoryFilter.description: Keep places whose Google Maps category contains all words of at least one entry, for example 'coffee' or 'italian restaur'. Leave empty for no category filter.
categoryFilter.title: Category filter words

extractEmailsFromWebsite.description: Visit each business website to collect contact details. Disable for a faster run with Google Maps data only.
extractEmailsFromWebsite.title: Find emails, phones and social profiles on the business website

language.description: Language of the Google Maps interface and listing text.
language.title: Language

locationQuery.description: Adds a shared location to every search phrase, for example 'Austin, TX, USA'. Leave empty when your phrases already contain the place.
locationQuery.title: Location (optional)

maxContactPagesPerWebsite.description: How many pages to read on each website: the homepage plus contact, about, legal, privacy or careers pages. More pages find more contacts but take longer.
maxContactPagesPerWebsite.title: Pages checked per website

maxEmailsPerWebsite.description: Maximum email addresses to keep for one business website.
maxEmailsPerWebsite.title: Emails per website

maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Maximum businesses to keep for each search phrase. Google returns a ranked window of roughly 160-220 places per phrase; asking for more simply returns what the source has.
maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Businesses per search phrase

mode.description: Choose how to find businesses. Search Google Maps by phrase, enrich a list of websites you already have, or look up specific Google Maps places.
enumTitles: Get contacts from a list of websites
mode.title: What do you want to do?

onlySaveResults.description: Save every business, only businesses where an email was found, or only businesses with any contact detail (email, website phone or social profile).
enumTitles: Only businesses with any contact detail
onlySaveResults.title: Which places to save

placeIds.description: Canonical Google Place IDs starting with 'ChIJ'.
placeIds.title: Google Place IDs

placeMinimumStars.description: Keep only businesses rated at least this high. Places without a rating are left out when a minimum is set.
placeMinimumStars.title: Minimum rating

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place links, copied from the address bar or from a previous export.
placeUrls.sectionDescription: Used when the selected mode is 'Scrape specific Google Maps places'. Provide place links, Place IDs, or both.
placeUrls.title: Google Maps place URLs

searchQueries.description: Natural-language searches such as 'coffee shops in Austin TX' or 'plumbers near Chicago'. Include the place in the phrase, or use the location field below. Each phrase is searched separately.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Used when the selected mode is 'Search Google Maps for businesses'.
searchQueries.title: Search phrases

skipClosedPlaces.description: Check each place's public status and leave out businesses marked closed. This adds one small request per place.
skipClosedPlaces.title: Skip permanently or temporarily closed places

websiteFilter.description: Keep all places, only places with a website, or only places without one.
websiteFilter.title: Website filter

websites.description: Websites to extract contacts from, one per line. Bare domains such as 'example.com' are accepted.
websites.sectionDescription: Used when the selected mode is 'Get contacts from a list of websites'. No Google Maps lookup is made.
websites.title: Business websites
